WhatWeDo.talentKicker: Have your dedicated team — minus the headache
WhatWeDo.talentBody: Fekra builds dedicated teams and delivers tailored software solutions from our hubs in Egypt. Our remote experts collaborate efficiently, giving you full control over your team while delivering exceptional quality, flexibility, and cost-effective results.
WhatWeDo.buildBody: At Fekra, we provide innovative digital solutions with dedicated remote teams — transforming your ideas into reality with loyalty, innovation, and expansion at the core of our values. Operating from Egypt and Saudi Arabia, we offer flexible, cost-effective services tailored to your business, without compromising quality.

Vetting.title: Your Success Starts With Our Vetting Process

steps.title: Job application
steps.body: We receive more than 2.5M+ applications from talented developers each year.

steps.title: Online tests
steps.body: The most promising candidates are assigned a variety of online tests.

steps.title: HR interview
steps.body: Next, we screen professionalism, adaptability, and communication skills with a deep-dive HR interview.

steps.title: Written test
steps.body: If all goes well, we examine creativity and problem-solving with some written tests.

steps.title: Technical interview
steps.body: The last step is a rigorous technical interview held by our in-house experts.

steps.title: Done!
steps.body: The top 3% of tech talent are hired and can start client delivery.
